reserveReview.rationale: Refresh 2026-09-29: River's own protocol dashboard now decomposes satUSD backing into product-level collateral lists, so the prior single undisclosed basket is replaced with three evidence-backed slices. (1) On-chain omni-CDP trove collateral of $46,668,112 (clBTC Arbitrum $37,717,472.64, clBTC Base $8,378,524.34, and $572,115 of residual branches): the two material clBTC branches were reconciled to pinned RPC reads of getEntireSystemColl()/getEntireSystemDebt() on the Arbitrum clBTC TroveManagerProxy at block 510062308 (449.9901 clBTC backing 9,645,850.28 satUSD of debt) and the Base clBTC TroveManagerProxy at block 51952263 (100.0021 clBTC); the Base uniBTC trove managers hold zero collateral, proving the dashboard's uniBTC rows are not trove positions. (2) Prime Vault custodial BTC of $107,330,000 (bfBTC on BNB Chain 655.00/$60.87M, uniBTC on BOB 205.00/$17.46M, uniBTC on Base 341.3682/$29.00M, staking factor 20%): uniBTC rows are counted once, in this bucket, because the on-chain troves hold none; custodians are unnamed in River's documentation. (3) Smart Vault custodial USDT of $17,620,553.57 across the two listed Ethereum vaults, both displayed claimable at review time. The three buckets total $171,618,666 against protocol-reported satUSD circulation of $137,077,438.42 (corroborated on-chain: satUSD totalSupply 79,352,049 on BNB Chain, 12,381,309 on Base, 10,801,687 on Arbitrum, 8,432,973 on Ethereum), a 125.2% aggregate collateral coverage. Slice percentages are computed from these same-day issuer-dashboard observations, so they carry the dashboard's pricing and product-scope completeness rather than a third-party aggregate.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Issuer protocol dashboard product-level TVL decomposition observed 2026-09-29 (omni-CDP Collaterals panel, Prime Vault vault list, Smart Vault vault list), with the material Arbitrum and Base clBTC trove branches reconciled to pinned on-chain reads at blocks 510062308 and 51952263
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All collateral locations River publishes are identified, and no undisclosed product surface appears in its documentation or app. Remaining issuer-described facts: Prime Vault and Smart Vault custodian identities, addresses, and segregation terms are undisclosed; vault-level completeness beyond the listed vaults cannot be independently verified; the share of circulation minted internally by vaults versus trove debt is not published; both Smart Vault USDT vaults are displayed claimable, so near-term USDT outflows are possible. The on-chain trove bucket is independently verifiable and was verified for the material branches.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: bfBTC and uniBTC are custodial BTC-collateral positions with undisclosed custodians and no on-chain trove balances; they are treated as an exogenous BTC envelope rather than a splittable or linkable basket.

The USDT vault deposits are issuer-dashboard-reported, not reconciled to published wallet addresses, and both vaults are claimable; USDT remains a candidate upstream rather than a linked dependency until the holdings are address-verifiable.
